purpose: Prove per-item fallback compiles to one isolated fanout fallback graph with full clause coverage and no acquisition.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_PER_ITEM_FALLBACK_002.json').read_text())['goal']
out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
assert out['compiler_mode']=='DETERMINISTIC_PER_ITEM_FALLBACK_FANOUT_PLAN',out
assert out.get('clause_coverage_verified') is True,out
assert sorted(p['index'] for p in out['compiled_parts'])==list(range(6)),out['compiled_parts']
acts=out['controller_actions']
assert [a.get('type') for a in acts]==['invoke_capability','invoke_capability_fanout','assert_runtime_per_item_fallback_decodes','finish'],acts
fan=acts[1]['args']
spec=fan['item_fallback']
assert spec['primary_action']['args']['capability_id']=='image.qr.generate.qrencode',spec
assert spec['fallback_action']['args']['capability_id']=='auto.apt.zint',spec
assert spec['primary_validation']['expected_source_field']=='email',spec
assert fan['copy_fields']==['id','username','email'],fan
print('PER_ITEM_FALLBACK_COMPILER_VERIFIED')
PY
